nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Melt-in Milk Body & Face Sunscreen Lotion SPF 100

avis.texte: Very creamy and effective powerful sunscreen! I am naturally tan but burn easily due to various dermatology prescriptions I've used throughout my life. Its been such a long journey finding a sunscreen that doesnt leave me excessively dewy and feel thick after the 3rd reapplication like the supergoop unseen.

I'm not sure if its possible the formula has changed recently, but a lot of reviews from a while ago say it burned their eyes, but my sensitive eyes are fine. I have active SLE, and need an unholy amount of SPF protection. This sunscreen does that for me. The only complaint is it tends to rub off on leather seats, like in the car.

I don't know if it's because it's SPF 100 but it's too thick imo. I have to really work it in and I feel like I'm tugging my delicate facial skin. Also, throughout the day, I guess as it melts a little bit, it burns my eyes. It does rub in completely clear for me and I don't think it's necessarily too heavy once it's on. It's just hard to spread. I wouldn't repurchase next time I need something a little bit easier to put on and reapply.
This lotion made my eyes burn and tear up sooooo bad. the next day my eyes were still red and really puffy. I'll probably use it up on my body,but Holy moly, not my face!
Burns eyes,kinda oily on the skin However it doesnt leave a white cast. ! But just very greasy

I bought this subscreen religiosly for 2 years. The mosy recent tube I bought was sadly not what I had been raving about in the past. I had never gotten a sun burn while using this sunscreen, but this time I proably burned the worst I have ever burned while using it.

avis.titre: Don't put this sunscreen near your eyes
avis.texte: This is a lovely sunscreen for your body. Takes a tiny bit of effort to rub in, but feels nice overall. However, do NOT put this sunscreen anywhere near your eyes. It burns so bad. 5/5 for the body 0/5 for the face

avis.titre: A must have for outdoor activities- No white cast
avis.texte: I discovered this sunscreen on Dr. Dray's YouTube. It offers excellent protection without burns or tan. Ideal for outdoor activities or vacations, it suits my medium, olive, acne-prone skin without leaving a white cast or causing breakouts.

No seriously, I'm baffled that there are so many good reviews! I had high expectations, but I found this sat cakey, sticky, left a slight white cast and pilled under and broke up my makeup. It even pilled on my legs, so I don't think it's due to to too much product on my face. And given how expensive it is, get outta here! The only thing I liked was the more natural finish as opposed to others that make you so shiny. There's much better out there.
been using this for over a year now and its my go to sunscreen. I love the feel and look of it after Ive applied it. Def do recommend.

ChatGPT recommended this to me over another brand I was using that I felt was drying me out. I love it! I don't feel it on my face, I am dry most of the time. I use it after a HA, daily moisturizer but before makeup. It doesn't feel like typical sunscreen. I have noticed an improvement to the wearability of my makeup, but I am also making several other routine changes right now. This folded in seamlessly! I have not yet worn it during a workout, since its winter and I am working out inside.

I have severely dry skin so this formula is helpful towards that. Anyone with normal or oily skin wont like this though. Doesnt sink into skin. Cant use under makeup. Stings the eyes for the entire day. Smells like a typical sunscreen. I prefer the formulations ive gotten off of yesstyle so much more.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging is simple and easy to use. It has no fragrance and no white cast and it absorbed fast. It's more on the liquid side but not watery. I do think it is effective in protecting my skin from the sun. I do recommend this to others to try.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It feels great on skin. Not overly oily. But leaves a white cast on brown skin and doesn't seem to mix well with other products. It left clumps of products on my face.

I have a lot of sun damage and have had skin cancer and pre-cancers. I need a lot of protection. This is a very rich cream formula, but it blends in well and doesn't sting my eyelids nor my sensitive skin. I use it for face and body.
I do not recommend it, the product melts very quickly and falls on the eyes which irritates and on the lips where its flavor remains. The skin looks very oily.

My skin will break out pretty quickly when it comes to sunscreen. I'm able to wear this sunscreen daily and I have never experienced a breakout. I also work outside in 100° weather and my face has never burnt while wearing this product ♥️
I have used this product with two different moisturizers and it keeps flaking off. I use it after washing my face and applying a light layer of moisturizer. My eyes also burn after applying it.
Both myself and my husband used this before going to the pool today and both of our eyes burned so badly! Even a while after washing my face really good they still burn.

Bought before going to FL for a few weeks. My porcelain skin did not burn at all! It absorbed quickly, did not cause me to breakout, did not leave my skin greasy and worked well under makeup. I used it on my face, ears, neck and arms and it worked great for me. Just be careful putting it near your eyes, it burned like crazy later in the day. Highly recommend this product!
I tried this sunblock once on my face and my skin was burning and left red marks on my face. Apparrently it's phototoxic and can cause chemical burns. Def don't recommend for sensitive skin.

It feels "runny" in the sense that it is so lightweight and blendable, But is not too liquidity. So far, I have been able to comfortably, use it as moisturizer, or with moisturizer, perfectly without Make-Up, and it also wears well under a full face.

avis.titre: Surprised by how pleasant this is
avis.texte: I expected this to be heavy and chalky but it is clear, goes on easily, does not have a heavy scent and works really well! I would definitely recommend it. It also does not cause the skin on my face to react, even though I use trentinoin.
I have combination + sensitive skin & my forehead clogs easily, this sunscreen blends into the skin so well, leaves the skin nice & glowy & doesn't irritate or clog my pores. as a esthi I APPROVE

avis.titre: Combo, Acne-Prone, 20-something Girl Approved (and her dad)
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen! I have used the SPF 60 version for a couple of years and then a year ago I decided to give this SPF 100 a shot to see if I liked it (and benefit from higher SPF!) or whether I should stick to the SPF 60. I have combo, acne-prone skin with an oily T-zone, an oil slick of a nose, and my under eyes have started to get drier. I'd describe the texture as a thick lotion so it works amazing during the winter months as a moisturizer too, but it's not too thick for the summer months and I don't find it to be too shiny! I find this version to be a little tackier and oddly a little less shiny (by like, a hair) than the SPF 60 so I loooovvee using this under makeup on a day when I'm spending time outside but need makeup on my face! The tackiness makes it so the sunscreen dries down faster than the 60 SPF had and I can place makeup in the areas I wanted. I really liked that because I felt like when I used eyeshadow there was no danger of it sliding where I hadn't placed it -- it just stuck to the right spot. I've never used this under foundation, however, because when I'm using this I'm gonna be outside and not really wanting foundation to potentially mess up my sun protection. My 62 yr old dad also loves this, although he loves Bondi Sands SPF more probably because that one feels even more moisturizing than this. My only con is that when I reapply this, I personally have to wash off the first layer and then reapply -- sometimes it feels like the reapplication layer

I have been using LRP's Anthelios Tinted SPF and really love it but wanted something that didnt have pigment in it. I absolutely love this SPF! Last year I used one by Cerave but have struggled to find it again. I prefer this one anyways because its a little thicker, which has made it easier to keep it out of my eyes. Ive only had an issue once because I had too much product. Will definitely continue to use this! It also sits great under makeup, not greasy at all!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I have been using this product since it was first brought to the US by Dr. Bryant at least 25 years ago. My skin looks at least 15 years younger than my actual age. I use it everyday 365 days a year. It's great.

I used the product on my face and it caused an itchy painful red bumps on my whole face even my eye lid (pictures indicated as "After"). It took about 72 hours to return to normal (picture indicated as "Before"). I have repeated and confirmed the reaction 3 times.
Pricey, but use small amount on both body and face. Not greasy and protects well. Have used this line for several years and have not been disappointed.

I bought this because I have rosacea and needed a higher spf but hated that other spfs smelled and felt like your typical sunscreen. The feel of this is super smooth and my face felt hydrated afterwards. However my skin pilled SOOOOOOO much. No matter what i did or how I changed the amount I put on. It also triggered breakouts for me in my t zone (I have combination skin). Since stopping it, I've realized a lot less flare ups. But as a sunscreen itself, it does its job.

Maybe I was unlucky and happened to get one of the defective products but this product was super flaky, did not blend well at all and dont even think about trying it under makeup. I've tried it out giving it a chance on different days of different occations/ events and all the same results I had to return it. I'd look insanely crusty and it was embarrassing I dont even have dry skin and I take very routinely care for myself. Very disappointed

I recently had pre slin cqncer removed from my ear. This sunscreen has been amazing! My whole family uses it, we used it at the beach when it was super hot and sunny; none of us gor burnt! It works really well. Female, light skinned- late 20's.
Melts in to your skin easily and provides high level of protection. So good for your skin like al lla roche posay products.

avis.titre: Don't use this sunscreen if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: Brought this sunscreen on vacation with me and i regret every bit, i used on my face and hands and started getting an irritation under my eyes/cheeks and started getting bumps on my hands, don't buy this product if you have sensitive skin

As someone with photosensitivity due to lupus I always look for a good sunscreen with 100 spf. Usually haveing to settle for 50 or 60, since these are more widely available and higher spf's leave a white cast. Although I am happy to say this has littlw no white cast (blends very well) and leaves you glowing.

So i bought 2 of these. Thinkining i could use this for my face. Its Very overpriced. I love that it has high coverage. When applied to my face its very thick and I look shiny and I feel like I can see my sweat. And stings if used near eyes. I will only use it for my body. And i will not purchase again.

I have both lupus and a condition called MCAS- the latter essentially meaning I'm allergic to anything and everything, and the "rules" of what I'm allergic to changes daily- this is the one and ONLY sunscreen that doesn't cause my butterfly rash to burn or trigger an even worse full faced MCAS rash, and even better: no acne! Literally everything breaks me out or causes a reaction but not this. I am so happy to have found this SPF. My skin no longer feels like I'm pressed against a hot skillet when I have to be outside anymore. Of course, always wear a sunhat and clothing layers to protect your skin, too! But this truly is a miracle product for me. I hope to never be without it. Please, please, please, never discontinue or stop carrying this product. I was in tears to find something that works for me. I've never loved a peofuct more.

I love this sunscreen, was using the spf 60 and found this spf 100 at ulta. It's hard to find. The last few years I have developed a sensitivity to the sun beyond what normal people do. This stops my sun reactions and I don't look grey. Re-apply!

okay this sunscreen is actually really good! it doesnt break me out(which my skin is super sensitive to break outs and redness), gives me a slight glow, and obviously its spf 100 which is lovely for my fair skin. however, i play tennis a lot and even when im out for like 5 minutes and this is on my face i sweat like CRAZY even though im not even hot or tired or any of that. and when i actually do get hot and work out for a long time dear lord it looks like i just went on a 5k marathon through death valley. it doesnt bug me that much cause its protecting my skin but it is sorta annoying. also omg for the love of god do NOT get this anywhere near your eyes. i got this near my eyes and no matter how much i washed them or wiped my eyes my eyes were burning for 3+ hours. literally. they were watering so bad and i was blinking every millisecond and couldnt barely do anything. other than that its a really solid sunscreen if one you dont put it near your eyes and two you dont mind sweating(if youre being active/doing sports).

It's been too long since I last used sunscreen, but I recently started again because my skin tone was becoming uneven and the UV index has been high lately, ranging from 6 to 9 between 10 AM and 4 PM. I've noticed that my skin is returning to its regular shade. As a person with brown skin who spends about two hours a day in the sun, I recommend applying sunscreen every 90 minutes if you're exposed for a long time. It's a great product!

avis.titre: Love this even more than the SPF 60
avis.texte: I honestly LOVE this formula. I was a little intimidated by the SPF 100 and was scared it was going to be thick and difficult to blend but I'm halway through my bottle and it's performing excellently! I've been using the SPF 60 for 3 years now and wanted to see if this was any different and I think I like this one better for makeup than the SPF 60. This one settles and dries down more than the SPF 60 surprisingly so I find it easier to apply makeup over this and I also dont feel like this gives me the "sunscreen sheen" on my face as much as fhe other one does which I found super surprising. There is a sliiight white cast but it's not really more noticeable than the SPF 60 white cast and both are pretty minimal. Can streak sometimes but that's very minimal too and I find it less streaky than the SPF 60 surprisingly. The only draw in my book is this tends to have a shorter expiration date than the SPF 60 but I'm sure it's hard to keep a ln SPF 100 formulation at 100 for an extended period of time. I hope they never discontinue this! Makes me feel more comfortable on the sunniest days (and ofc I reapply)
I use this specifically on my HEALED tattoos to keep them as protected as possible

It works just as advertised. Other sunscreens leaves chalky, greasy film on skin. This product doesn't while still keeping you protected. A bit pricey but worth it. No more ruining cloths, furniture, or marks on your vehicles interior with white smudges.
please watch out and read the ingredient list that according to FDA are dangerous and can cause health problems

I really wanted to love this product. I don't have sensitive skin, but this had the SPF i was looking for, and it had a nice texture. However, my skin started looking red, and I though perhaps I wasn't applying it correctly, or enough. So I was applying this product every two hours at work. But my skin stayed red, and started to become bumpy. I stopped using this sunscreen, and the next day the redness calmed down. I'm absolutely heartbroken, and I have no idea what ingredient I could be reacting to! The only allergy I'm aware of that I have is to wool, but I don't think there's any lanolin in this product. I'm sure this is an excellent product for others, but I'm afraid I'll have to give mine away. Disappointing!

avis.titre: Amazing for Body! Keep Away from Eyes…
avis.texte: I really liked how this sunscreen had a high SPF, didn't feel super greasy, and didn't have whitecast. I absolutely loved it as a body sunscreen. My issue came with using it on my face. I would put it everywhere except near my eyes but they still burned. every. single. time. This is the first time I've experienced this with a facial suncreen.
I wanted to love this sunscreen, but it made me itch; I believe it's the vitamin B5 (panthenol). I didn't experience this with LRP's sunscreen with HA, so I know this sunscreen was the problem.
This Arizona gal just loves this formula for hands & arms and chest/neck. Seriously when the UV rating is over 10 (last summer got to 14) using a serious SPF product is the only way to go.

It was my first time trying the la roche 100 spf sunscreen during my vacation in the Bahamas, and lets just say I am never going to any other brand! My skin ALWAYS burns, I swear I am essentially a vampire with how delicate my skin is, but this sunscreen saved the day! I reapplied as needed, and made sure to allow it to dry fully before attempting to get near water.
After 60 years of golf and tennis, I've had several MOHS and I need the best protection from the sun. Although this product is very expensive, I need the best protection I can get, this 100sp works.

This sunscreen/spf is maybe a 50-70 spf. I am used to using Neutrogena 100+ (that was removed from the market). It was the best at protection. La Roche Posay 100 burns me and puts brown spots on my nose and back of hands. I am so disappointed since Neutrogena 100 is gone. Won't be purchasing La Roche sunscreen again. I do use La Roche for my face and am happy with it.

I have stubborn and recurring melasma. After searching some Reddit subs, alot of people said that spf 100 protected their skib better. This product is not greasy for me and i wear it over a moisturizer. It doesnt pill for me either. It makes my skin glow and there is no white cast. I have dark brown skin.
I've been using this for over a year. No white cast, great under my makeup. In the sunshine state of AZ sunscreen is a MUST! Highly recommend!!

I switched to my Lamer 50 spf when i need high spf . Price point totally different from expensive ones. Just avoid eye area coz seriously it will irritate in just a second. Above all I seriously love it. Its my everyday protection.
i liked it, its a very good product, goes smooth on the skin but, since i have oily skin this product wasn't on of my favorites since it made my skin more oily

avis.titre: Lovely Sunscreen, but it stains clothes
avis.texte: I love the texture of this sunscreen, it's thick and creamy but not greasy or overwhelming. It blends into skin quickly as well. The only down side is that it stains clothing pretty badly. I use this on my kids and all of my son's sweatshirts have stains around the neck and hoodies. They are very bright yellow, and while they can be removed with some laundry magic, I hate having to do that.

avis.titre: Love this product but it makes me look oily
avis.texte: This product "melts" onto the skin, but my skin doesnt really absord it & my face looks greasy all day long. It hasnt made me break out and im currently trying to tackle my acne, so homestly i dont care if i look greasy right now if it means i dont have active pimples. Do not put it in the orbit of your eye (under your brow/under your eye), because it burns so bad if you rub your eye or do soemthing to get it in your eye. I had to use the eye wash station at school because my eyes were uncontrollably crying from how bad it burns. Overall though i really like this product because it gets the job done, feels lightweight, doesnt make me break out, and doesnt make me look white
I ABSOLUTELY LOVE LOVE LOVE this sunscreen. Ive been using it for about a year now and I will probably forever be using it.

I hated this product, I bought this thinking it would do well for my sensitive skin and had a horrible allergic reaction. My and entire face was itchy and had red splotches. My skin was swelling red and itchy around my eyes. This product also made my skin extremely greasy 30 minutes after I applied it to my skin. Overall I hated this product and I feel like I wasted my money.
LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS SUNSCREEN. As it says, it melts into your skin. It is fragrance free which I appreciate because I have sensitive skin. This is a must have!
Fianlly i found this suncream . It's soft, fast dry and finish really well. I like it. I don't want something make my face too oily. I alway use this after moisture my skin everyday. I love it

I bought this for the high SPF for no-makeup pool days and because the ingredients are supposed to be good for acne prone skin. The protection is great, but this formula irritates my skin if used frequently. To be fair, I have annoyingly sensitive skin, but if you do as well it could cause a problem for you too

I use this everyday rain or shine as part of my morning routine. I live on the coast and am often outdoors. My fair skin burns easily, so I need something that really works all day. This is the best product I have ever found. It lasts from morning to night

I really like this sunscreen when I don't wear makeup. it blends right in, and very little eye irritation if any at all. I applied it then went right to working out and my eyes didn't sting. However, under makeup it doesn't work well

I have been using this sunscreen for over a month. It takes a bit of time to rub in. When it does it literally melts in like milk. It also leaves my skin glowing. It does peel after a few hours. But just reapply to fix it.

avis.titre: not a cost-effective sunscreen, get something else
avis.texte: overpriced, doesn't prevent getting darker, I really wanted to like this because of the hype online, but it is not worth it at all. The only good thing is that it doesn't leave a sticky feeling, but it's protection against the sun is subpar. I've had better experience with Hawaiian Tropic. Will not buy again nor I do recommend this if you get easily dark under the sun.

The only sunscreen I ever use! Perfect for your face and body. Melts into your skin like a dream! Works well under makeup, especially in the summer months. I love that this sunscreen does not leave a white cast and doesn't leave you feeling greasy/sticky like other sunscreens.
I really like this sunscreen because it doesn't leave any white cast after applying, and it leaves my skin with a nice glow. It feels very lightweight, and there's no scent!

avis.titre: Finally found the perfect sunscreen for me < 3
avis.texte: I loved Supergoop sunscreen, but it having oils as an ingredient made me breakout and even provoked multiple styes (learned the hard way to never apply any sunscreen near eyes). Having to discard my favorite sunscreen I bought multiple LaRoschePosay alternatives and this is the one! It absorbs beautifly and doesn't leave a white cast, which is the qualities I loved from Supergoop. Also, no breakouts and it gives me a beautiful glow. Love love love.

avis.titre: i wanted to love it so bad but…
avis.texte: i decided to try this sunscreen after seeing all of the good reviews that it had. within the first few days, i noticed that it blends very well into the skin, and does NOT leave a white cast at all but it left a greasy feeling on my skin and made it look super shiny and oily, i ended up realizing that it broke me out :( !!! and i no longer will be using it but this sunscreen is def not bad jus wasnt suitable for my skin !
Is it just me? Many reviews are saying there is no sunscreen smell, etc, but mine definitely smells like burnt rubber. A bit off-putting.

I went on a trip to Forida and bought this for my face to avoid the damaging sun and it did not work for me. It was not pleasant around the wye area and it actually was burning and stinging my chin and cheek area. It worked on my shoulders but for the face it was no.

avis.titre: Unexpectedly small tube but wouldn't go without it
avis.texte: In the past I've always used the SPF 60 melt in sunscreen and jumped at the change to increase the coverage to SPF 100. I was surprised that the tube was much smaller than the lower SPF and it is almost empty after daily use on face and hands in a short time. That being said it is highly effective and unlike many sunscreens it has not made me breakout. I will be replenishing often— my justification for the high price is its much less expensive than skin cancer treatment and worth the extra expense. I only wish the tube was bigger.

Went to Florida for a week and was looking for something to protect me while I was in the sun all day, everyday. It felt nice and there wasn't any white cast or stinging. I have hormonal-acne prone skin that's sensitive and didn't have any troubles with it. The only trouble I seemed to have with it was using it around my eyes. After it set, I rubbed my eyes and it stung my eyes. It lasted for a while afterwards, so I would be careful with usage around the area and not to rub anywhere near your eyes. Other than that, it helped me from getting super sunburnt. Will purchase next vacation!

I was looking for a good sunscreen that I could use for my face and body. I brought this with me on a trip and as soon as I started to sweat it dripped into my eyes and stung. It's not sweat proof even though it's water resistant. I liked it for my body just not my face. Find another product for face.

avis.titre: I love the way my skin looks.
avis.texte: This product is very good for my skin…My dermatologist had recommened it and since then i have been using it for about a year.

Loved this product and works well with my skin. I even have a peach fuzz beard and a lot of sunscreens leave white spots that don't come out. This sunscreen does not do that after a bit of rubbing it around. I use it exclusively for my face and the bottle lasts me a long time -- especially during the summer when I apply multiple times throughout the day.

avis.titre: Great sunscreen for dry skin; i love using it on my face
avis.texte: I really like this sunscreen because it is hydrating, it makes my face glow, and there is no white cast at all. I will mention that my skin is more on the dry side and the sunscreen can leave a bit of residue so beware if you have oily skin.
It has a strong chemical scent, and it pills in the face. Does not absorb into the skin. Watery consistency.

avis.titre: Excellent sunscreen for sensitive skin and eyes
avis.texte: This is one of the best sunscreens I have used. I have extremely sensitive skin and eyes. This one goes on lie a moisturizer, lasts for a long time and doesn't both either my skin or my eyes. I spend a lot of times outdoors in the sun and my skin has never looked better
Product seems to be runny in humid temperatures. Ran in my eyes and even after I washed off my eyes hurt the rest of the day.

The most important part of the review, does it work? Yes! I have beyond pale skin. It doesn't ever build up a tolerance to the sun. It's really hard to find a great sunscreen for my skin, and this one has so many plusses. I purchased the sunblock 100. It does not stink at all. That's really huge for me! It goes on very smoothly. And I can be out in the sun for an hour and no burn. The price? Absolutely fair. I don't even look at other brands at this point and I just hope that Laroche Posay always has the sunblock 100 available. I recommend this 1000%.
The sunscreen does its job well and is not greasy at all. I have a very light complexion and sunburn easily. This one works.

I LOVE this product. Ive been using it for maybe a year now and its never given me any issues. Melts perfectly into my skin leaving it so soft & hydrated. It doesnt even feel like sunscreen, it feels like another moisturizer! I have pretty acne prone skin and this product doesnt give me any break outs unlike most sunscreen :) try it out!
I love this sunscreen for my brown skin. Does not leave a white cast, blends well, and doesn't burn my eyes. It is very oily/glowy tho, so if you don't wanna look a little too glowy don't get this!!
I tried this several times and cant get past the smell. Smells like gasoline when it soaks into your skin.

I just started using this sunscreen this summer and I'm in love! It definitely does "melt" into your skin and its so quick and easy to apply. I like that i can use it for my face and body and i dont have to worry about breaking out. It also doesnt have that heavy or sticky feeling you get with other sunscreens.
No white cast! I live that i Can use the same tube on my whole body. I also like the size of the bottle….great for throwing into a bag for the day.

avis.titre: Wore everyday out to sea on my Nordic skin
avis.texte: I used this and only this on my face and ears everyday I went deep sea fishing for up to 12 hours in the open sea and sunshine. I had ZERO burns. I have Nordic skin so my skin burns easily and I require sunblock . This was no exception! All 8 days I applied liberally and lasted all day. I will always put trust in their products. Been using LRP sunblock for many years. BTW makeup does not pill if you layer foundation over this. I had to look pretty fishing ya know ! ;) You won't be disappointed.

This is my favorite sunscreen for the summer months when I need high waterproof protection. I've never burned using this as long as I reapply every hour and a half. Slight sunscreen smell- but that doesn't bother me as it melts into the skin like nothing.
I love this sunscreen!! It feels lightweight on the skin and it doesn't smell!!!! And it spf 100 and it's for the body tooooo!! I would definitely recommend this!!!!!!
I used this sunscreen when I went on vacation and my face normally burns so easily but I did not get burnt! It truly does melt into your skin. It doesn't feel greasy or leave any white cast.
Buy! buy! buy! It will keep your skin baby smooth doesn't break you out. Good to apply under your makeup and no white cast. I'm darker skinned so I appreciate the no white cast. La roche posay 10/10

I've been dealing with PMLE and have tried a handful of sunscreens but this one has been my saving grace ! My face doesn't break out after sun exposure , this doesn't leave a white cast . My favorite sunscreen ! You need to try it!

avis.titre: Very good on all skin type
avis.texte: I really love La Roche-Posay because of how it leaves my skin feeling very good dewy feeling you guy must cop this before it sells out!! Best purchase ever I love it so much!!

￼first of all the price of this one is affordable for all of us. ￼ ￼ Those who have sensitive skin will love this product so much. Honestly, I don't like to put sunscreen on my skin because I feel like it's a blocked pores. But this one completely changed my mind about the sunscreen protecting my skin. It was 100F but my skin still did not burn. This, I can use it for a light for almost 3 months and it is perfect not only for you but for your child.

POV: dry skin, 18 years old Rating: 7 out of 10 I would give it an eight out of 10, but it's over priced. I won't lie, I have repurchased this product along with the majority of Laroche Posey's sunscreens, but I believe there's products are over priced, so I switched to Korean sunscreens instead. This sunscreen will leave a milky, glowing finish. If you have dry skin, this is perfect for you. I love how it has UVA and UVB protection. it made me feel like like my skin was highly protected out in the sun.
